what: On the board, an 8px square follows the cursor late with .45s power3.out, leaving a 2px tail line (a curve smoothed three times over the latest 30 points, the 14px near the head left empty, fading toward the tail). A point-symmetric flipped twin square and tail around the board’s center move together on the opposite side. When the cursor leaves the board, the square vanishes and the tail shrinks one point at a time — a quiet cursor decoration over the hero photo

options.gap: Distance to clear at the head side (px), default 14
options.mirror: If off, a single square with no paired square or tail
options.--fx-color · --fx-dot: Box · tail color and box size (CSS variables), default --kf-contrast-ink · 8px

note: On devices with no pointer or with reduced motion, nothing is attached

from.where: index.html·about.html Hero [data-slot=hero] — original ATF cursor canvas: quickTo .45 power3.out, tail 30 points · 14px · line 2, point-symmetric mirror at center
